import base64

r_script = '''#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_file)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == "287") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98") return(0.0)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA)
}

dat$Proportion <- mapply(compute_proportion, dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio)
dat_sub <- subset(dat, !is.na(Proportion))
cat("Data rows after filtering:", nrow(dat_sub), "\\n")
cat("Proportion range:", range(dat_sub$Proportion), "\\n")

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2), data = dat_sub)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2) + I(Proportion^3), data = dat_sub)
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df = 4), data = dat_sub)

aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

cat("AIC Quadratic:", aic_quad, "\\n")
cat("AIC Cubic:", aic_cubic, "\\n")
cat("AIC Spline:", aic_spline, "\\n")

aics <- c(Quadratic = aic_quad, Cubic = aic_cubic, Spline = aic_spline)
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\\n")

best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  Spline = m_spline
)

obj_fun <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(Proportion = p)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

opt <- optimize(obj_fun, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\\n")
cat("Max predicted area:", opt$objective, "\\n")

out <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aic_quad,
  AIC_Cubic = aic_cubic,
  AIC_Spline = aic_spline,
  OptimalProportion = opt$maximum,
  MaxPredictedArea = opt$objective
)

write.csv(out, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done.\\n")
'''

script_b64 = base64.b64encode(r_script.encode()).decode()
print(script_b64)

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_file)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == "287") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98") return(0.0)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA)
}

dat$Proportion <- mapply(compute_proportion, dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio)
dat_sub <- subset(dat, !is.na(Proportion))
cat("Data rows after filtering:", nrow(dat_sub), "\n")
cat("Proportion range:", range(dat_sub$Proportion), "\n")

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2), data = dat_sub)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2) + I(Proportion^3), data = dat_sub)
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df = 4), data = dat_sub)

aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

cat("AIC Quadratic:", aic_quad, "\n")
cat("AIC Cubic:", aic_cubic, "\n")
cat("AIC Spline:", aic_spline, "\n")

aics <- c(Quadratic = aic_quad, Cubic = aic_cubic, Spline = aic_spline)
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\n")

best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  Spline = m_spline
)

obj_fun <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(Proportion = p)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

opt <- optimize(obj_fun, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\n")
cat("Max predicted area:", opt$objective, "\n")

out <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aic_quad,
  AIC_Cubic = aic_cubic,
  AIC_Spline = aic_spline,
  OptimalProportion = opt$maximum,
  MaxPredictedArea = opt$objective
)

write.csv(out, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done.\n")
ENDOFSCRIPT
